description: Parses a human-readable duration string into structured seconds. Supports combinations of y (years), mo (months), w (weeks), d (days), h (hours), m (minutes), s (seconds). Examples: '2h30m', '1d6h', '1w3d', '45m'. Returns the total seconds for the duration. Use when normalising a free-text duration for arithmetic or comparison.
name: parse_duration
